description: This file implements the QuicTimeWaitListManager class and related components for managing time-wait state in QUIC protocol, including handling connection IDs, sending reset packets, and managing timers.

classes.name: ConnectionIdCleanUpAlarm
classes.description: Alarm delegate class that triggers cleanup of old connection IDs in QuicTimeWaitListManager.

classes.name: TimeWaitConnectionInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a connection in the time-wait state, including termination packets, active connection IDs, and timing info.

classes.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager
classes.description: Manages the list of connection IDs in the time-wait state, handles packet processing, resets, and timer-based cleanup.

classes.name: ConnectionIdData
classes.description: Data structure storing per-connection information such as packet count, timestamp, action, and connection info.

methods.name: FindConnectionIdDataInMap
methods.description: Finds connection ID data in the internal map.

methods.name: AddConnectionIdDataToMap
methods.description: Adds connection ID data to the internal map.

methods.name: RemoveConnectionDataFromMap
methods.description: Removes connection ID data from the internal map.

methods.name: AddConnectionIdToTimeWait
methods.description: Adds a connection ID to the time-wait list with specified action and info.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdInTimeWait
methods.description: Checks if a connection ID is in the time-wait list.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes an incoming packet for a connection in the time-wait list, possibly sending resets or termination packets.

methods.name: SendPublicReset
methods.description: Sends a public reset packet, either IETF or Google QUIC.

methods.name: SendPacket
methods.description: Sends a packet via the writer.

methods.name: BuildIetfStatelessResetPacket
methods.description: Builds an IETF stateless reset packet.

methods.name: SendOrQueuePacket
methods.description: Attempts to send a packet or queues it if the wire is blocked.

methods.name: WriteToWire
methods.description: Writes a queued packet to the network.

methods.name: SetConnectionIdCleanUpAlarm
methods.description: Sets the timer for cleaning up old connection IDs.

methods.name: MaybeExpireOldestConnection
methods.description: Expires the oldest connection in the list if it has lived past the expiration time.

methods.name: CleanUpOldConnectionIds
methods.description: Performs cleanup of expired connection IDs.

methods.name: TrimTimeWaitListIfNeeded
methods.description: Trims the list to maximum size if needed.

methods.name: GetStatelessResetToken
methods.description: Generates a stateless reset token for a connection ID.
